$Comment: The restless graveyard's boss wave: the Voidtaken Horseman rides out. Zc_Encounter_Endless runs it
once, in the tick a boss wave rises (its BossWave slot, named by
Seasons_Of_Orbis_Restless_Graveyard_Encounter), so everything here happens in that one tick.
In order. TriggerSpawners fires the SpawnMarker standing within SummonRange of the script's entity
(Seasons_Of_Orbis_Voidtaken_Horseman_Marker, on the plaza's north side) and binds the Horseman it raises
into the script's Voidtaken slot. A marker fires only once the creature it raised last has died, which by
a boss wave he always has: no wave is beaten while one of the run's creatures lives. Then, with him bound,
the boss bar points at him under BarName, the game's own bar, shown to every player in the run; it follows
him by his id and goes away once his body does. Then Signal goes out (zc:wave, as every wave of the run
sends), and Moment's banner tells each member he rides. The library stands the wave until he falls,
The slot is never Boss on purpose: the library reads a fight's Boss slot as the subject it credits, scales
and pays for, and an endless run has none. Bound anywhere else he is one of the run's creatures, so
each return takes the dungeon's per-return ramp, and the binding row's Scale.Adds grows him with the
party. Since he comes from a spawn marker rather than the Spawn action, the mob scaling mod leaves him

SpawnMarker.Description: The manual spawn marker standing in the arena's prefab that raises the boss.

SummonRange.Description: How far from the script's entity the spawn marker may stand to be fired.

BarName.Description: The lang key the boss bar shows, resolved on each player's own client.

BarRange.Description: How far from the script's entity the bound boss may stand to be given the bar.

Signal.Description: The beat sent as the wave rises: zc:wave, or zc:wave:<label>.

Moment.Description: The FeedbackMoment each member is shown as he rises. Empty shows nothing.

Instructions.$Comment: He rides out of his marker, bound into the Voidtaken slot.
With him bound, the bar points at him.
The wave's beat, then the banner, after the signal so the wave count it carries counts this wave.
